markets: Global: Milan, Paris and Florence runways; premium and mid-market menswear
title: SS27 Men's Partywear Styling
summary: Party SS27 menswear: satin shirts and sets, crystal and studded denim, sheer shirting and gold.

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body: Satin, including a golden V-neck and floral satin sets<sup>[1]</sup>; studded and crystal denim at Dolce & Gabbana, Louis Vuitton and Philipp Plein<sup>[1]</sup><sup>[2]</sup>; sheer shirting<sup>[1]</sup>; coral-like beading at Dolce & Gabbana<sup>[2]</sup>.

sections.heading: Formulas
sections.body:
- **Floral satin set.**
- **Studded jeans + black shirt.**
- **Sheer shirt over a rib tank + black trousers.**
- **Gold knit + tailored trousers.**

design_implications: - Line sheer and beaded pieces where they touch skin.
commercial_implications: - Partywear sells close to events; buy shallow, deliver late spring.
